set.body: Scope: PRD Phase 0. Inventory every production file importing two principal domains, all current LNA representation branches and manifest variants, and the exact current build edges. Resolve the effect/resource surface, owned Tensor2 boundary, and authoritative response-time model with JVM and Scala.js evidence; record the remaining decode, manifest, artifact-name, duplicate-selection, and receipt decision gates. Acceptance: current bridge tests remain green; no source is moved; every cross-domain responsibility has a named target owner; the target module DAG and compatibility baseline are explicit; unresolved choices are recorded rather than hidden in implementation.
set.title: RRA 0: freeze the contract, inventory seams, and decide foundations
